تختتنين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَتِنِينَ (taḵtatinīna) /tax.ta.ti.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# تُخْتَتَنِينَ (tuḵtatanīna) /tux.ta.ta.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
